contract: construct() -> exactly 401 distinct edges [u, v] on vertices 0..39. The score is the largest book: the maximum over edges of the number of triangles containing that edge. Minimize; the theorem of Edwards and Khadzhiivanov-Nikiforov gives score >= 40/6.
